name: Groovy Palette
description: Thirty more entries on the COLORS row: Amiga Workbench, the C64 boot screen, a Virtual Boy, an amber terminal, plus rainbow, fuchsia, vaporwave and the rest. PACKS narrows the list to RETRO or COLOUR when thirty extra rungs is too long a walk. Every palette is checked by luminance, because a Game Boy palette that does not fall in brightness reads inside out.
